name: id
description: Unique identifier for the crime record.

name: date
description: Date when the incident occurred. this is sometimes a best estimate.

name: case_number
description: The Chicago Police Department RD Number (Records Division Number), which is unique to the incident.

name: arrest
description: Indicates whether an arrest was made.

name: primary_type
description: The primary description of the IUCR code.

name: description
description: The secondary description of the IUCR code, a subcategory of the primary type.

name: district
description: Indicates the police district where the incident occurred.

name: ward
description: The ward (City Council district) where the incident occurred.

name: community_area
description: Indicates the community area where the incident occurred. Chicago has 77 community areas.

name: block
description: The partially redacted address where the incident occurred, placing it on the same block as the actual address.

name: location_description
description: Description of the location where the incident occurred.

name: latitude
description: The latitude of the location where the incident occurred. This location is shifted from the actual location for partial redaction but falls on the same block.

name: longitude
description: The longitude of the location where the incident occurred. This location is shifted from the actual location for partial redaction but falls on the same block.

name: location
description: The location where the incident occurred in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal. This location is shifted from the actual location for partial redaction but falls on the same block.

name: updated_on
description: Date and time the record was last updated.
